emma_sales: Heads up — Prospect (Mercury Health) POC asks for concrete capacity plan for a 12-month reserved commit. Requirements: 100 RPS steady, spikes to 280 RPS for up to 10 minutes, avg 50 tokens/response, model = quantized 13B with KV cache. They need reserved GPU count, autoscale policy, preheat plan, and high-level pricing. Also stuff for security questionnaire (CMK, audit).

leo_solutions: Got it. SLO asked: p95 <= 350ms. Acceptable fallback to smaller model if we document tradeoffs.

rita_eng: Quick back-of-envelope: steady tokens/s = 100*50=5k tps. Peak tokens/s = 280*50=14k tps. Our quantized 13B throughput ~8k tps per GPU under steady batching. Recommendation: reserve pool = 2 GPUs to cover steady+buffer, burst credits to cover 2k-6k tps spikes. Autoscale policy: start at 2, scale by +1 when util>70% for 45s or queue>25, cooldown 8m, max 4. Provide automatic fallback to quantized 7B if scale unavailable.

omar_sre: Preheat: rolling KV warmup 8m ahead of predicted window. Warmup job hitting representative prompts at ~25 RPS for 6m. For Private deployments, ensure warmup runner has appropriate IAM role and no credential persistence. Add runbook note: abort warmup if error rate >2%.

tara_billing: Ballpark pricing: 2 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs ~ $YYk/mo, burst credits pool priced separately. Will prepare formal quote by EOD.

emma_sales: Security Qs from customer: can we support CMK, provide audit export, and explain retention?

omar_sre: CMK: yes (AWS/GCP KMS) for Private & hosted with contractual CMK enablement. Audit: console exports to S3 or GCS + syslog integration. Retention: configurable, default minimal retention unless customer opts in.

infra-bot: playbook created -> /playbooks/preheat/mercury-warmup.yaml

rita_eng: I'll attach a runtime config snippet and a short SLO-vs-fallback doc comparing 13B and 7B quality/latency tradeoffs. Action items: rita confirm per-GPU tps test run (ETA tomorrow), omar finalize warmup runbook (EOD), tara deliver quote (EOD), leo assemble FAQ and security answers (EOD).

emma_sales: I'll send the customer: reserve 2 GPUs, burst credits, autoscale to 4, preheat plan + security Qs. No blockers flagged. :thumbsup:
